method: Decoded Draco GLB; ordinary Three AnimationMixer; actual SkinnedMesh.getVertexPosition; 120Hz plus Float32 key times +/-1e-7 and +/-1e-6 seconds and event boundaries
limitations: Full-body vertices are sampled for fall_roll and get_up; every clip includes all dominant foot vertices, rigid board and rigid pole vertices.
Board-relative joint drift checks attachment stability, not the visual fit of a boot or binding.
The virtual desktop renderer is separate from physical phone performance.
